name: verdict-outside-kind-yarn
description: Commands that must pass after the Outside kind is added; they mirror the CI checks job. Keep install named "install" for fingerprint skip across attempts.

commands.name: outside-kind-check
commands.purpose: Grep the Kind enum for Outside, check the payoff table test exists and run the contract test file.

commands.name: lint
commands.purpose: Lint the frontend and the contracts with no warnings allowed, as CI does.

commands.name: check-types
commands.purpose: Type check both packages (the hardhat one prints nothing on success).

commands.name: frontend-tests
commands.purpose: Frontend unit tests, which cover the payoff lib, the question text and the diagram helpers.
